title: Floating Machi Koro-style provincial strip club illustration spec
purpose: Central illustration for a red Machi Koro-style establishment card.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the central content illustration to be composited onto an existing blank card template.
integration_context.background_requirement: Genuinely transparent background. No sky, header, footer, card furniture, text, coin, icon, frame, or backdrop.
integration_context.text_policy: Absolute no-text rule: no letters, numbers, words, prices, labels, written signs, logos, graffiti, license-plate characters, or pseudo-writing on any surface. The two requested neon signs must be pictorial silhouettes only, with no lettering.
integration_context.card_relationship: A floating miniature object or sticker inside the card's open middle region, with generous transparent space around it.
integration_context.central_positioning: Centered, compact, self-contained, fully visible, with ample margin on every side.

style_goal.primary_rule: Match the cute simplified establishment-art language of the original Machi Koro tabletop game without copying a specific illustration.
style_goal.secondary_rule: Depict a recognizable provincial post-Soviet nightlife venue through the gray building, pictorial neon, queue, and doorman.
style_goal.core_formula: Cute simplified board-game miniature plus a deadpan provincial strip club.

what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.miniature_scene_feel: A small isolated toy-like scene, like a board-game token or floating diorama, not a full landscape.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.shape_language: Large clean shapes, simple geometry, compact clustered forms, and a crisp readable silhouette.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.perspective: Loose playful three-quarter view facing slightly right, showing the front and right side of the building.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.linework: Clear outlines or sharp form separation with sparse interior detail.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.shading: Simple graphic shading with one or two darker tones, never realistic lighting.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.materials: Concrete, glass, cloth, and neon communicated by color and silhouette rather than texture.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.detail_density: Low to moderate and readable at small card size.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.silhouette_priority: The compact four-story block, two pictorial neon signs, entrance queue, and broad doorman must read instantly.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.scene_boundary: The building and people rest on one compact stylized pavement slab and do not blend into a background.

visual_composition.occupancy: Compact horizontal subject intended to occupy about 30-45% of card height after compositing.
visual_composition.shape: One squat four-story gray building with its entrance and queue clearly visible, plus two large pictorial neon silhouettes mounted on different facade planes.
visual_composition.floating_behavior: The entire scene floats in transparent space and never connects to the card skyline.
visual_composition.base: A small rounded patch of worn pavement and curb belonging entirely to the miniature.
visual_composition.background: None; transparent pixels outside the miniature.

russian_grimness_rules.principle: Provincial post-Soviet bleakness comes from the utilitarian building and restrained wear, not realism.
use: bright red, pink, and cyan pictorial neon accents
a deadpan queue of overdressed patrons
russian_grimness_rules.guardrail: Preserve the cute board-game miniature rendering and express locality through object choice and palette.

warm_accents: bright pink-red and cyan neon silhouettes
palette.saturation: low to moderate, with pictorial neon as the clearest accent
palette.overall_brightness: clean and readable, slightly subdued, harmonious with a red card template

general: Reduce the whole scene to a compact iconic miniature.
Use only the few features needed for immediate recognition.
Keep all forms chunky and readable.
Show the building facing slightly right, with front and right side visible.
building_specific: Use a squat utilitarian four-story gray concrete building with a flat roof and simple rows of dark rectangular windows.
Place a recessed entrance with a small plain geometric canopy on the front facade.
Mount a glowing martini glass outline with one olive on one facade plane and a tasteful simplified female pole-dancer silhouette in bikini on the other facade plane.
The pole-dancer sign must remain a non-explicit pictogram: fully covered bikini areas, no anatomical detail, no nudity, and no sexual act.
Do not include fascia panels, written signboards, menus, posters, logos, or any surfaces that invite generated writing.
Keep the walls, roof, windows, and entrance divided into only a few large geometric masses.
environment_specific: Show a short orderly queue of four or five solid middle-aged men in dark business suits leading to the entrance.
At the door, show one broad muscular bouncer wearing a tight plain short-sleeved T-shirt and dark trousers, arms folded.
Keep every person fully clothed, toy-like, simplified, and non-identifiable.
Use a tiny self-contained pavement-and-curb base and no surrounding street.
Avoid cars and license plates so there is no surface likely to acquire text-like marks.

content.subject: A provincial four-story gray strip club with pictorial neon signs, a queue of suited men, and a muscular bouncer.
content.description: A squat gray concrete nightlife building in a right-facing three-quarter view. One side carries a glowing martini glass silhouette with a single olive; the other carries a tasteful simplified bikini-clad pole-dancer silhouette. Four or five well-dressed men queue toward the recessed entrance, where a broad bouncer in a tight plain T-shirt stands guard.
content.desired_read: An unmistakable but non-explicit provincial strip club rendered as a cute floating Machi Koro-style miniature.
recognition_details: four-story utilitarian gray building with a recessed entrance
large pictorial neon martini glass outline with one olive and absolutely no letters
large tasteful bikini pole-dancer neon silhouette on a different facade plane and absolutely no letters
short queue of solid middle-aged men in dark suits
broad muscular doorman in a tight plain T-shirt at the entrance
content.miniature_base: A compact rounded patch of worn dark pavement with a short concrete curb, fully isolated on transparency.
simplify: architecture, people, and neon into chunky toy-like masses
facade detail into a few readable windows and flat color areas
wear into one or two restrained color patches
omit: all words, letters, numbers, prices, labels, written signs, logos, posters, graffiti, license-plate characters, and pseudo-writing
blank signboards or fascia panels that invite generated text
nudity, explicit anatomy, sexual acts, or provocative close-up posing
cars, streets, neighboring buildings, trees, and full scenery
realistic textures, dramatic lighting, and full-card composition
content.target_impression: The same whimsical illustrator who drew classic Machi Koro establishments has drawn a mildly seedy provincial nightlife venue, with the pictorial neon, solemn queue, and oversized bouncer providing the visual joke.

anti_patterns: Do not generate a full card.
Do not generate any background, sky, clouds, header, footer, frame, coin, or category icon.
Do not create a realistic architectural rendering or a full streetscape.
Do not generate any text or text-like marks anywhere, including on clothing and neon signs.
Do not turn either neon pictogram into letters or a written venue sign.
Do not depict nudity, explicit anatomy, sexual acts, or realistic erotic detail.
Do not clip the building, roof, neon silhouettes, people, pavement slab, or their shadows.
final_prompt_summary: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent central illustration for a Machi Koro-style establishment card. Generate only a compact floating miniature scene: a squat provincial four-story gray concrete strip club in a loose three-quarter view facing slightly right, showing front and right side. One facade plane has a large glowing outline pictogram of a martini glass with one olive; the other has a tasteful simplified neon pictogram of an adult woman in a bikini posed beside a pole. Keep the pictogram non-explicit, with covered bikini areas, no anatomy, no nudity, and no sexual act. A short orderly queue of four or five solid middle-aged men in dark business suits leads to the recessed entrance. A broad muscular bouncer in a tight plain short-sleeved T-shirt and dark trousers stands at the door with folded arms. Put everything on one small rounded pavement-and-curb slab. Cute simplified board-game illustration, chunky toy-like shapes, clean outlines, sparse detail, flat graphic shading, cold gray palette with bright pink-red and cyan neon accents. Genuinely transparent background with ample margin around the complete silhouette. Absolute no-text rule: no letters, numbers, words, prices, menus, labels, written signs, logos, graffiti, license-plate characters, pseudo-glyphs, or blank signboards anywhere. No sky, scenery, neighboring buildings, cars, card frame, coin, category icon, photorealism, cinematic lighting, heavy texture, explicit content, or clipped content.
